status.label: Retest Keyboard Manager launch and runtime
status.detail: The v0.99.1 Windows 10 report says Keyboard Manager cannot open after the runtime installer was launched; a collaborator's question about the launch path is unanswered.

judgment.rationale: The report lists PowerToys v0.99.1 from the Microsoft Store on Windows 10 and says a missing-SDK error prevents Keyboard Manager from opening. The author downloaded and ran WindowsAppRuntimeInstall-x64 but could not tell whether installation completed; a PowerToys report ZIP and screenshot are attached. A collaborator asked whether the user was opening Keyboard Manager through PowerToys Settings, but the author has not replied. No assignee or matching PR was found. Ask for the current-build result, launch path, and exact error/runtime-install outcome if the failure remains; do not request the attached archive again.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys v0.99.1 from the Microsoft Store and Windows 10.
The reporter says the missing-SDK error persists after launching WindowsAppRuntimeInstall-x64, whose console closes without a clear completion message.
A PowerToys report ZIP and screenshot are attached.
The only comment asks how Keyboard Manager is opened; the author has not answered.
No assignee or matching PR was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the issue still occurs on v0.102.3001, how Keyboard Manager is opened, and what Windows build and exact missing-SDK message appear if it still fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: If current stable still fails, a missing or unregistered Windows App Runtime dependency may be preventing Keyboard Manager activation. The exact runtime requirement and installation outcome are not established by the report.

proposed_fixes.title: Resolve Keyboard Manager's missing runtime dependency
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Keyboard Manager process may fail to activate because a required Windows App Runtime package is absent, unregistered, or incompatible with the installed PowerToys package. The report does not identify the exact required runtime or whether its installer completed.
plan: Reproduce the missing-SDK error on the reported Windows 10 installation and capture the exact runtime/version named by the error.
Verify the PowerToys package dependency and installed runtime registration against the supported deployment requirements.
If the dependency is missing or incompatible, correct the package/runtime prerequisite or provide a precise actionable installation error.
Add a launch test for the supported runtime-present and runtime-missing cases.
verification: Verify Keyboard Manager opens on a supported Windows 10 build with the required runtime installed.
Verify a missing runtime produces a clear, accurate remediation path rather than an unexplained launch failure.

confidence.rationale: The reported error explicitly points to a missing SDK/runtime, but the precise dependency and installer outcome are unknown and the report is from v0.99.1.
